The applicants should furnish the areas in which they have been

DRAT and other forum etc.;

(b) PAYMENT TERMS:--
The standing counsels as mentioned at Sr. No. (1) here-in-above are
eligible of 50% Advance Payment of Fees on filing of cases and the
Standing Counsels for Title Search are eligible of 50% Advance
Payment on allotment of assignment by the Official Liquidator and
remaining fee of 50% on completion of cases / assignment.
(c) REIMBURSEMENT OF EXPENSES:--
The Standing Counsels and Counsels for Title Search are eligible for
reimbursement of expenses towards Court Fees, Typing Charges &
other misc. expenses on presentation of bills from Common Pool
Fund maintained by the Office of the Official Liquidator.
TERM OF ENGAGEMENT/EMPANELMENT:--
(1) Initial engagement/empanelment - The term of
engagement/empanelment shall be for a period of two years or until
further orders, whichever is earlier, there after extension/renewal
may be considered by the Hon'ble High Court depending on the
performance of the Counsels / advocates. However, no counsel will
be eligible for renewal after completion of third term or completion
of period of 6 years of engagement which ever is earlier.
(2)Termination of engagement/empanelment - The empanelment of the
Counsels / Advocates may be terminated by either side at any time
without assigning any reason.
PROCEDURE FOR SELECTION OF PANEL COUNSELS / ADVOCATES /
DRAFTING COUNSELS:--
Notices inviting applications from the interested eligible advocates will
be displayed on the notice board of the Hon’ble High Court, notice
board of Bar Council of Gujarat, DRT , other Forums and the notice
board of the office of the Official Liquidator as well as field offices of
Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Also notice inviting applications to be
webcast on the Website of the Hon’ble High Court of Gujarat and
Ministry of Corporate Affairs. There would be a committee comprising
Official Liquidator , Registrar General of the Hon’ble High Court , and
the Additional Solicitor General or any other counsel from the panel of
the Central Government as may be nominated by Additional Solicitor
General. The committee shall examine the applications received and
after short listing the names of eligible and suitable advocates for

placing in the panel of advocates in the different categories, shall place
such list before the Hon’ble Company Court for approving the panel of
the advocates.
OUTSTATION WORK OF THE STANDING COUNSEL / PANEL ADVOCATE /
DRAFTING COUSNELS & COUNSELS FOR TITLE SEARCH:--
The Panel Standing Counsels / Panel Advocate should attend the Court
at Ahmedabad during the period of his engagement / empanelment.
However, if required they will move out of Ahmedabad for which they
are entitled for Travelling Expenses , Dearness Allowance , Hotel
Expenses on actual basis, the details of the same areas under:-
(1) Travel/Hotel Expenses & Dearness Allowance - The Standing
Counsel , Panel Advocates & Counsels for Title Search will also
be entitled to travel expenses for travel by Air (economic class)
or Second A.C. by train, road mileage for the journey from his
Ahmedabad to the Airport/Railway Stations and vice-versa and
from the Airport/Railway Stations to the place of his stay out of
Headquarters and vice-versa at the rates admissible to Group
A/Class | Officer of the Central Govt. He will also be paid a lump
sum amount of %1,200/- per day as conveyance charges for
performing local journey and %1,000/- Dearness Allowances per
day while moving outside the Ahmedabad. He will also be
entitled to reasonable actual expenses for stay in Hotel, subject
to maximum of %5,000/- per day.
RIGHT TO PRACTICE AND RESTRICTION:-
(1) The Counsel / Advocate will have a right to private practice which
should not, however, interfere with the efficient discharge of his
duties as a Counsel / Advocate for the Official Liquidator.
(2) Counsel / Advocate shall not advise any party in or accept any
case against the Official Liquidator in which he has appeared or is
likely to be called upon to appear for or advice or which is likely to
affect or lead to litigation against the Official Liquidator.
GENERAL:-
(A) No fee will be admissible for “preparation” but the Official
Liquidator will get approval of Hon’ble Company Court and may
consider payment of separate fee for preparation in special cases
involving arduous work.

(B) Two or more cases in which substantially identical questions of
law or facts are involved and where the main difference is in the
names addresses of the party concerned, amount of money
involved etc. where the common or identical judgment are
delivered are irrespective of the fact whether all the cases are
heard together or not. In such cases the Standing Counsels shall
be entitled for 10% fees payable on the main matter.
In the event of any doubt or difference regarding the fees, the fees
determined by the Hon'ble Company Court shall be final and binding
The Hon'ble Company Court can modify / alter & relax any of the
provisions contained in this scheme if need arises.
